description.text:
About the job:
We are seeking a self-motivated and detail-oriented engineer to join our algorithm team. The role aims to assist healthcare application development, especially in algorithm refinement and validation implementation.
What you will be doing:
- Employ machine learning and statistical techniques to refine the boundary conditions of the software.
- Design and implement comprehensive experiments and evaluation metrics for ablation study to carefully validate the performance and limitations of the software.
- Write formal technical documents and testing reports.
What we need to see:
- BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, etc, or equivalent practical experience.
- Basic knowledge of fundamental theory and practice of digital signal processing, pattern recognition and statistical analysis.
- English writing skills.
- Communication skills.
- Programming skills in Python and C/C++.
Way to stand out from the crowd:
- Practical experience with image processing and computer vision.
- Experience with multi-thread programming is a plus.
